title: Research artifact: A Verification-Bound Commit and Recovery Protocol for Heterogeneous Telemetry Archival
description: Model, counterexample traces, fault-injection harnesses, independent byte-exact oracle, raw run records, analysis scripts, and generated tables and figures for the VTOP paper (manuscript prepared for IEEE Transactions on Cloud Computing). Results are pinned to vtop-engine v0.7.0 (commit 6c8f386). Loghub data is not redistributed; fetch scripts and checksums are included.
